physicalNotes: Radius 1.57 +/- 0.16 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-100 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,092,249 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.77 +/- 0.42 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-100 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6900 +/- 120 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-100 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
